title: Reproducing Hijikata et al. 2013: growth rate against thickness on both faces of 4H-SiC

sample.paper: “4H-SiC C face” and “Si face”; Figure 1 caption “(0001¯) C-face”; Figure 5 “(0001)Si-face”

sample.note: Song's constants are for on-axis research-grade wafers.

sample.paper: not stated; the C-face data at 1 atm start at 5 to 12 nm “since the oxide growth in thin thickness region was too fast to follow”
sample.ours: the program's 0.2 nm, plus the assumed time to the first point

sample.paper: “dry oxygen ambient at a pressure of 1 atm”

history.item: Loaded into the in-situ ellipsometry furnace and heated
history.paper: not stated in the chapter: “The experimental details can be found in the references [8, 9, 10].”
history.note: Heat-up gas and time, and when the oxygen is admitted, are in the cited papers, not here.

history.item: Dry oxygen until the first point read (2.6 nm)
history.paper: not stated: the first rate read on Figure 1 is 6.9 nm/h at 2.6 nm; time zero is not given
history.ours: RUN ToFirstPoint DURATION 1348.04 TEMP 890->890 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: The time to grow the first 2.6 nm is unknown. 2.6 nm at the first measured rate (22 min) is ours: a rate that was at least this high before means it is an upper bound. Searched from 1 s to 2 h.

history.item: Dry oxidation at 890 °C, 1 atm, from the first to the last point read
history.paper: “The oxide growths were executed under dry oxygen ambient at a pressure of 1 atm.”
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 62435.3 TEMP 890->890 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: The duration is reconstructed: the time to go from 2.6 to 78 nm at the measured rates, integrated over the points read from Figure 1 (17.34 h). The chapter gives no times.

history.item: Growth rate measured in situ by spectroscopic ellipsometry
history.paper: “we have, for the first time, performed real-time observation of SiC thermal oxidation using an in-situ ellipsometer [4, 5]”
history.ours: the observable Thickness, at the reconstructed times
